title: A Charge to Keep I Have
description: A Charge to Keep I Have in Tonic Solfa to BOYLSTON: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the four verses, and a piano.
about: Charles Wesley’s words were published in 1762. Lowell Mason wrote the tune BOYLSTON in 1832.
underlay: A charge to keep I have, A God to glo-ri-fy, A nev-er-dy-ing soul to save, And fit it for the sky.

lines: A charge to keep I have,
And fit it for the sky.
Oh, may it all my pow’rs engage
As in Thy sight to live;
And O Thy servant, Lord, prepare
Help me to watch and pray,
Assured, if I my trust betray,
